scenarios.name: driver/psycopg-default/auto-prepare
scenarios.description: psycopg 3.3.6 (Python), default settings (prepare_threshold = 5), with autocommit on as most apps use it: The same parameterized query run more times than the driver's auto-prepare threshold, then the same on another connection.

scenarios.name: driver/psycopg-default/same-names-different-sql
scenarios.description: psycopg 3.3.6 (Python), default settings (prepare_threshold = 5), with autocommit on as most apps use it: Two connections take turns with different queries, so drivers that number statements per connection give both the same name.

scenarios.name: driver/psycopg-default/same-sql-both-connections
scenarios.description: psycopg 3.3.6 (Python), default settings (prepare_threshold = 5), with autocommit on as most apps use it: Two connections take turns with the same query, so drivers that name statements by their text prepare the same name twice.

scenarios.name: driver/psycopg-default/transaction
scenarios.description: psycopg 3.3.6 (Python), default settings (prepare_threshold = 5), with autocommit on as most apps use it: Queries that cross the auto-prepare threshold inside a transaction, then another connection reads what it committed.
